responsibility: This autogenerated companion to sparc.opt maps SPARC target command-line options to their GCC manual anchors. It belongs to the target option metadata layer rather than backend code generation, providing UrlSuffix entries for SPARC-specific switches such as floating-point, VIS level, ABI width, cpu/tune selection, code model, erratum workarounds, and memory-model options so the generated option tables can associate those switches with the SPARC-Options manual documentation.
